execution_state_and_caching.name: Top-to-bottom script execution

execution_state_and_caching.dangerous_pattern: Perform database writes, emails, or remote API mutations while rendering page headers or widgets.

Is any side effect idempotent and behind an explicit submit/confirm/service boundary?

Verify status/result state is deterministic after rerun.
